name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs is an AI audio platform providing an AI voice generator and voice-agents platform for creating lifelike speech.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: 30k credits/month; adds commercial license, instant voice cloning.

tiers.name: Creator
tiers.notes: USD 22/month ongoing on monthly billing; the displayed USD 11 is a 50%-off first-month offer, not the renewal price. Includes 121,000 credits/month. Taxes are extra.

best_for: ElevenLabs positions itself for enterprises needing customer-service voice solutions, creators/content producers (audiobooks, podcasts, video), developers building via API/SDK, and government agencies.
features: Dubbing with emotion preservation across languages
pros: Ultra-realistic voice synthesis with nuanced emotional expression, pacing control, and instant voice cloning
Comprehensive multilingual speech support spanning 70+ languages with automated voice dubbing and translation
Low-latency developer streaming API and conversational AI voice agents with built-in guardrails
cons: Monthly character quotas can deplete quickly during long-form audiobook production or high-volume voice agent traffic
Professional voice cloning (PVC) requires high-quality studio audio samples and manual identity verification
Free plan requires attribution and restricts commercial usage rights

alternatives.name: Murf AI
alternatives.description: AI voice generator and studio with slide presentation synchronization.
alternatives.best_for: Voiceovers synced to video and slide decks

alternatives.name: Descript
alternatives.description: Text-based audio and video editor with AI voice cloning (Overdub) and automatic transcription.
alternatives.best_for: Podcasters and video creators editing speech via transcript

alternatives.name: Synthesia
alternatives.description: AI video generation platform transforming text into videos with photorealistic avatars.
alternatives.best_for: Corporate training and multilingual video production
